title: Dredging footprint pipeline
description: AIS-based mapping of trailing-suction hopper dredging, seabed disturbance and first-year sediment-carbon remineralisation, with annual SVR cap, OCIM forcing and uncertainty assessment. Source-only reconstruction of the October 2026 GRIT workflows; external inputs and the full production environment are not supplied. See README.md for validation scope and remaining gaps.
notes: Prepared metadata for version 2.0.0; release and Zenodo activation are pending. No DOI has been assigned.
